name: e-Fatura
description: Electronic invoice created in the form required by the Communique; exchanged through the e-Fatura application.

name: e-Arşiv Fatura
description: Electronic invoice created outside e-Fatura for recipients who are not e-Fatura users; same legal nature as a paper invoice.

name: e-İrsaliye
description: Electronic despatch advice (sevk irsaliyesi) created in the form required by the Communique.

name: e-İrsaliye Yanıtı
description: Electronic document showing the buyer's acceptance status for the goods covered by an e-İrsaliye.

name: e-Bilet
description: Electronic ticket created, signed with an electronic certificate, and stored electronically.

name: e-Sigorta Komisyon Gider Belgesi
description: Electronic insurance commission expense document replacing the paper commission expense document.

name: e-Sigorta Poliçesi
description: Electronic insurance policy issued by insurers and intermediaries.

name: e-Döviz Alım-Satım Belgesi
description: Electronic foreign-exchange buy and sell documents of authorised dealers.

name: e-Dekont
description: Electronic advice (dekont) issued by banks and institutions listed in VUK Communique 435 §2.

name: e-Adisyon
description: Electronic restaurant check (adisyon) under the Communique.

name: e-Defter
description: Electronic journal and general ledger under VUK and the Turkish Commercial Code (separate e-Defter application; not an e-Belge invoice document).
